assets.name: 真空斩
assets.scene: Visual event: a gigantic upright shearing VACUUM BLADE launched forward. Match Image 1: Wylder low at the lower-left, shown from rear three-quarter with torso pitched forward, one bent knee lifted and the sword finishing a powerful release, while a towering thin VERTICAL white/cyan compressed-air crescent fills the right two-thirds. assets.revision_prompt:

Change ONLY the small silver POMMEL at the far left end of the blue sword grip, next to the low sword hand at lower center. It currently resembles a polygonal round knob. Replace that knob with Wylder's distinctive forked sculptural silver pommel from Image 2: a small axial central base with two prominent hooked silver branches opening upward/downward around it, a third small central prong, negative space between branches. Keep it compact, graphic and cel-shaded, but unmistakably forked, not a ball or disk.
CRITICAL invariant: keep the central base of pommel, blue grip, crossguard center and long steel blade all collinear on the EXISTING straight shallow down-right sword axis. Decorative outer branches may curve; the core axis must NOT bend. Do not add a second handle or second pommel.
Preserve EVERYTHING else in Image 1: composition, pose, flame fan from outstretched hand, helmet, back buckler, armor, fingers, sword hand, blue grip length, existing crossguard and perfectly straight steel blade, flat color palette and hard black cel-shadows, original landscape aspect ratio. Do not redraw the character or move the fire. No new text, border, cards, UI or watermark. Opaque full-bleed game card art, final 1000x760 ratio.
